name: World Orchestra
scope: Audio band energy reveals the generated world in three zones. Supply an RGB band_map to assign low/mid/high bands to custom regions. Default zones are horizontal. Frequency bands are not isolated musical instruments.

name: Impossible Duet
scope: A delayed, translated generated silhouette is composited beside the source. Supply a tracked subject_mask for a real silhouette. Default is an explicit ellipse preview. This does not synthesize independent choreography or physically correct floor shadows.

name: Portal Paint
scope: Generated video appears inside region_mask, with a beat-pulsed luminous rim. Default is a centered ellipse. Connect subject_mask to preserve foreground occlusion. Draw your region in ComfyUI Mask Editor on a LoadImage node and connect MASK.

name: Reality Scrubber
scope: An editable normalized time:mix schedule blends source and generated takes. This is a crossfade compositor, not geometric scene reconstruction or a live draggable frontend slider.

name: Foley Orchestra
scope: Set source_impact_seconds to the visible impact in both banks. The compositor alternates source/generated action snippets, aligning that marked event to BPM or explicit beats. Original music is preserved. It does not detect impacts or compose new musical audio.

name: Future Echo
scope: Four translated delayed silhouettes reveal generated textures with channel-color variants. Supply subject_mask for tracked silhouettes. Default ellipse is a placeholder. These are temporal echoes, not four independently generated characters.

name: Motion Becomes Matter
scope: A motion centroid accumulates a fading trail that reveals the generated texture. With a subject_mask it follows that mask centroid; otherwise frame differences drive it. Camera motion can disturb it. This is a 2D reveal effect, not physically simulated water or 3D terrain.
